Conversation 2 pushes detailed rear-panel-off instructions on him unprompted, makes slightly dubious claims ('damage the appliance further', 'damaging your home's wiring'), and its final heading presumes element replacement before any test. Conversation 1's mismatched burning-smell boilerplate in turn two is a minor blemish but doesn't outweigh these.
